verdict.rationale: Rippling documents that employees can request time off in its app and that time off syncs with payroll from a single system. That covers the request-to-payroll flow of the story. However, nothing in the pack shows defining PTO policies, configuring accrual rules, or a PTO-specific approval chain; the documented approvals concern hours and pay runs. Missing for 10: PTO policy definition, accrual configuration, PTO approval workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
